name: Prepare Garden Beds
description: Amend the soil with compost and other nutrients to prepare for spring planting.

name: Clean Up Garden
description: Remove dead plants and debris from the garden to prevent pests and diseases over winter.

name: Mulch Perennials
description: Apply a layer of mulch around perennial plants to protect them from the cold.

name: Test Soil pH
description: Test the soil pH to determine if any amendments are needed for the upcoming season.
